notes: 15-min capture (timeout 900, ~14.7 min recorded). Canonical decode (no dc_block) Peak SNR 1.53 dB, viterbi BER mean 0.24, deframer 100% NOSYNC, 0 CADU. Cross-check decode with --dc_block=true gave 13 KB CADU / 13 ASMs (all real GK-2A: SCID 195, mix of VCID 0+63). Link margin ~158x worse deframer yield than 2026-05-17 first-light at same flags. Positioning change did not help. Same ~1.5 dB Peak SNR ceiling as 2026-05-17. SD card moved physically to NAS (wifi too slow). IQ retained for re-decode.

SatDump gk2a_lrit baseband, cu8 @ 2.4 Msps, gain 25.4, dc_block=true. Viterbi SYNCED continuously, deframer never locked. 2.1 MB CADU written but 31 LRIT CRC fails / zero valid LRIT packets / no images. SatDump Peak SNR plateau 0.982 dB. FFT band-power confirms real GK-2A signal centered exactly at 1692.14 MHz (BPSK-shaped ±100 kHz envelope, stable through full 20 min) but only +3.6 dB above edge band-avg / ~+5 dB above noise at peak bin — below lock threshold. Diagnosis: link budget shortfall (likely pointing alignment / polarization sense / coax loss), NOT decoder config. IQ pulled from Pi SD card mounted at /mnt/pi-sd. IQ moved to needs-review.

SD-card transfer (Pi powered off post-capture). 600s @ 1691.0 MHz, 2.4 Msps, gain 40, cu8. SatDump elektro_lrit pipeline (BPSK 294 ksps, conv+concat, dc_block=true): viterbi NOSYNC + BER ~0.43 throughout, 0 CADU. FFT band-power probe (band_power_probe.txt in pass dir): LRIT band vs far-edge gap 0.2-0.4 dB at t=60/300/540s -> no LRIT signal in IQ. L5 retry skipped: elektro_lrit pipeline is identical for L3/L5; no satellite-id distinction at modem layer. Lone -503 kHz narrow spur near end of capture, unrelated. IQ -> needs-review/ for 7-day retention. Suspected causes upstream of decoder (chain/pointing/LNA/no-broadcast-slot); not investigated this session.

First-light Elektro attempt; 10-minute capture aligned with the 06:42Z slot. Viterbi NOSYNC, BER ~0.43, FFT band-power 0.2 dB above edges. Either the dish wasn't on the bird, polarisation was wrong, or L5 wasn't transmitting in that slot.

M2-4 LRPT, --lna --gain 25 (pole, V-dipole). SatDump v2.0.0-alpha-8ce9d5b, --dc_block=true. Peak SNR 2.2 dB, real SNR 0 dB, 0 CADU. FFT verification: LRPT band -54.83 dB, edge -55.3 dB → +0.5 dB above edge (noise only). Tests May 14 plan (--lna --gain 25 to recover from front-end compression); plan did NOT recover signal. IQ in needs-review for re-decode/analysis.

M2-4 LRPT, --lna --gain 25 (pole, V-dipole). SatDump v2.0.0-alpha-8ce9d5b, --dc_block=true. Peak SNR 3.6 dB, real SNR 0 dB, 0 CADU. FFT verification: LRPT band -51.44 dB, edge -55.7 dB → +4.3 dB above edge (CLAUDE.md threshold ≥5 dB). Borderline noise, no decode. Tests May 14 plan (--lna --gain 25 to recover from front-end compression); plan did NOT recover signal. IQ in needs-review for re-decode/analysis.

Pole-mounted V-dipole + --lna --gain 25 (noise-floor experiment from 2026-05-14 plan). SatDump --dc_block=true. 0 viterbi locks, BER stuck ~0.41. IQ moved to needs-review for 7-day retention. dataset.json mis-IDed as METEOR-M1 (expected when no frames decode). Pi REPORT.md claimed 44.2 dB SNR / polarization mismatch — DC-spike artifact per CLAUDE.md memory.

DIAGNOSTIC capture (not a pass): 60s baseline noise at 137.900 MHz, gain=25 (no LNA), V-dipole E-W at POLE position (~3.6m). Part of noise-floor experiment 2026-05-14. Noise floor (edge 300-500 kHz): 46.16 dB — 7.5 dB QUIETER than stool at same gain. Overturns prior hypothesis that pole-height move raised the floor. See /satellite/_diagnostics/2026-05-14_noise-floor-experiment/REPORT.md

DIAGNOSTIC capture (not a pass): 60s baseline noise at 137.900 MHz, gain=25 (no LNA), V-dipole E-W at ORIGINAL STOOL position (~1.2m). Part of noise-floor experiment 2026-05-14 to disentangle gain/height/environment. Noise floor (edge 300-500 kHz): 53.63 dB (matches May 12 baseline within 0.4 dB). See /satellite/_diagnostics/2026-05-14_noise-floor-experiment/REPORT.md

17.9 min capture, no Viterbi lock (0/34), CADU 0 B. CORRECTED DIAGNOSIS: NOT polarization mismatch. FFT shows noise floor at ~76 dB across whole 1 MHz baseband; May 12 IQ at same SDR/freq had 54 dB floor (delta +21 dB). Pi REPORT 'avg SNR 19.7 dB' is DC-spike artifact (cu8 zero-bias, fixed 88-dB single-bin at f=0) mistaken for signal — same misread documented for 2026-05-13 entry. Probable primary cause: tuner gain 44.5 dB drives R828D front-end into compression on horizon-level interferers newly visible to 12-ft antenna; lowering gain to ~25 dB is the first thing to try. Re-decode of preserved May 12 IQ through current SatDump yielded 2.2 MB CADU (vs 179 KB original) — processing is verified fine. Image data at /satellite/meteor-m2-4/2026-05-12_1435/_redecode_2026-05-14/MSU-MR/.

V-dipole N-S orientation (single-variable change from 2026-05-12_1435 E-W partial baseline). Pass cut short at 14:30 IST (≈16 min real signal + 2 min noise tail) due to IMD lightning warning; antenna retrieved early. Peak SNR 4.3 dB, Viterbi BER ~0.41 throughout (no lock), deframer NOSYNC entire pass. Pi-side REPORT.md monitor SNR (26.7 dB avg) is DC-spike-dominated and misleading; lock%=0 is truer. Pi setup.txt was unedited template (known template-leakthrough issue) — N-S orientation note exists only in operator message. SatDump auto-ID says METEOR-M1 in dataset.json which is a fallback on no decoded channels; pipeline run was meteor_m2-x_lrpt (no _72k variant exists in this build). 2026-05-14: re-decoded with 4 SatDump flag combos (--dc_block on/off × --iq_swap on/off, plus --rs_usecheck + --fill_missing). Best result was --dc_block=false --iq_swap=true: 8 brief Viterbi locks with BER ~0.03 but 0 deframer locks → 0 CADU. No images possible. Retry artefacts at /satellite/meteor-m2-4/2026-05-13_1414/_retry_2026-05-14_no_dc_block_iq_swap/. IQ moved to needs-review for 7d retention.
